dedupe_keys.name: glad global annual cropland dynamics 2015 2024 30 m

description: Annual global maps of cropland extent at 30 m. The GLAD page says the 2015-2024 annual cropland extent was derived from the Landsat Analysis Ready Data archive, with cropland defined as land used for annual and perennial herbaceous crops for food, forage and biofuel, as described in Khan and co-authors (2026) in Remote Sensing of Environment. Each year is available as a Google Earth Engine image collection and as a free download of 8-bit LZW-compressed GeoTIFF tiles of 10 by 10 degrees in WGS84, with a pixel value of 100 marking cropland. Coverage is global. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article (doi:10; reuse terms therefore remain unverified.1016/j.rse.2026.115438) is CC-BY-4.0. For simulation it shows where cropland expanded or was abandoned each year, to update exposure of farmland to floods, droughts and conflict. A related catalogue record is the GLAD global cropland extent and change 2000-2019.
